'''Michael Thaddeus''' (born January 12, 1967) is an American mathematician and a professor of mathematics at [[Columbia University]].<ref>{{Cite web |last=Diep |first=Francie |date=March 16, 2022 |title=Columbia Is Ranked No. 2 by 'U.S News.' A Professor Says Its Spot Is Based on False Data |url=https://www.chronicle.com/article/columbia-is-ranked-no-2-by-u-s-news-a-professor-says-its-spot-is-based-on-false-data |access-date=August 23, 2023 |website=[[The Chronicle of Higher Education]]}}</ref> He is best known for having been a [[whistleblower]] in exposing inaccurate data submitted by Columbia University to ''[[U.S. News & World Report]]'' (USNWR)'s [[U.S. News & World Report Best Colleges Ranking|Best Colleges Ranking]] to inflate the university's [[college ranking]].<ref>{{Cite web |date=2022-09-16 |title=Columbia whistleblower on exposing college rankings: 'They are worthless' |url=https://www.theguardian.com/us-news/2022/sep/16/columbia-whistleblower-us-news-rankings-michael-thaddeus |access-date=2022-09-17 |website=[[The Guardian]] |language=en}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web |last=Mendoza |first=Jordan |date=September 12, 2022 |title=Columbia University admits to reporting inaccurate data for US News college rankings |url=https://www.usatoday.com/story/news/education/2022/09/12/columbia-university-incorrect-data-us-news-college-rankings/10358383002/ |access-date=2022-09-17 |website=[[USA Today]] |language=en-US}}</ref>

== Early life and education ==
Thaddeus was born on January 12, 1967, in [[New York City]], and grew up in [[Morningside Heights]]. His father, [[Patrick Thaddeus|Patrick]], and his mother, Janice, both held doctorates from Columbia. Thaddeus was educated at [[St. Hilda's & St. Hugh's School]] before enrolling at [[Hunter College High School]] in 1980, where he graduated in 1984.<ref name=":3">{{Cite web |last=Bernstein |first=Noah |date=February 28, 2023 |title='The loyal opposition': Meet Michael Thaddeus, the math professor who took on Columbia |url=https://www.columbiaspectator.com/news/2023/02/28/the-loyal-opposition-meet-michael-thaddeus-the-math-professor-who-took-on-columbia/ |access-date=2023-08-24 |website=[[Columbia Daily Spectator]]}}</ref>

Thaddeus matriculated at [[Harvard University]], where his sister was also a student, with the intent to study biology but switched to mathematics.<ref name=":3" /> He graduated in 1988 and was awarded a [[Rhodes Scholarship]] to study at [[St John's College, Oxford]], where he earned his [[Doctor of Philosophy]] (DPhil)  under the supervision of [[Simon Donaldson]].<ref name=":0">{{Cite web |title=PBK - Michael Thaddeus |url=https://www.pbk.org/Michael-Thaddeus |access-date=2022-09-17 |website=www.pbk.org}}</ref><ref>{{Cite news |date=1987-12-07 |title=32 FROM U.S. CHOSEN FOR RHODES SCHOLARSHIPS |language=en-US |work=The New York Times |url=https://www.nytimes.com/1987/12/07/us/32-from-us-chosen-for-rhodes-scholarships.html |access-date=2023-08-24 |issn=0362-4331}}</ref> His dissertation, ''Algebraic Geometry and the Verlinde Formula'', was published in 1992.<ref>{{Cite thesis |title=Algebraic geometry and the Verlinde formula |url=https://ora.ox.ac.uk/objects/uuid:12af7dda-26f7-44ec-b335-74193ce1c538 |publisher=University of Oxford |date=2016 |degree=PhD |language=English |first=M. |last=Thaddeus}}</ref>

== Academic career ==
In 1994, Thaddeus was elected a Junior Fellow of the [[Harvard Society of Fellows]].<ref name=":2">{{Cite web |title=Michael Thaddeus {{!}} Professor |url=https://columbia.discovery.academicanalytics.com/scholar/stack/48892/MICHAEL-THADDEUS?unitId=4442&unitType=2 |access-date=2023-08-24 |website=Arcade - Public Access |publisher=[[Columbia University]]}}</ref> He was a postdoctoral researcher at the [[Mittag-Leffler Institute]] and the [[Simons Laufer Mathematical Sciences Institute]] from 1994 and 1997.<ref name=":3" /> In 1998, Thaddeus joined the mathematics faculty of Columbia University.<ref name=":0" /> He has lectured at multiple institutions including [[Hunter College]], [[Virginia Tech]], and [[Creighton University]], among others.<ref name=":0" /> He specializes in [[algebraic geometry]].<ref name=":1" />

Thaddeus was a member of the School of Mathematics at the [[Institute for Advanced Study]] in 2001.<ref name=":2" /> From 2017 to 2020, he was the chair of the math department at Columbia University.<ref name=":3" />

=== Columbia rankings exposé ===
Thaddeus' exposé, "An Investigation of the Facts Behind Columbia’s U.S. News Ranking,"<ref>{{Cite web |title=Columbia and U.S. News |url=https://www.math.columbia.edu/~thaddeus/ranking/investigation.html |access-date=2023-07-23 |website=www.math.columbia.edu}}</ref> was published in February 2022, identifying discrepancies such as shrunken class sizes and the exaggeration of faculty credentials.<ref name=":1">{{Cite news |last=Hartocollis |first=Anemona |date=2022-03-17 |title=U.S. News Ranked Columbia No. 2, but a Math Professor Has His Doubts |language=en-US |work=[[The New York Times]] |url=https://www.nytimes.com/2022/03/17/us/columbia-university-rank.html |access-date=2022-09-17 |issn=0362-4331}}</ref> Due to Thaddeus' analysis, Columbia later dropped from having been ranked 2nd to being ranked 18th, [[Criticism of college and university rankings (North America)|sparking speculation]] about the integrity of college rankings.<ref>{{Cite news |last=Barron |first=James |date=2022-09-13 |title=Columbia Loses A-Plus Status in U.S. News Rankings |language=en-US |work=[[The New York Times]] |url=https://www.nytimes.com/2022/09/13/nyregion/columbia-loses-a-plus-status-in-us-news-rankings.html |access-date=2022-09-17 |issn=0362-4331}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web |date=2022-03-06 |title=Columbia professor questions university's #2 ranking on U.S. News |url=https://www.nydailynews.com/new-york/education/ny-columbia-university-us-news-rankings-discrepancies-20220306-af7hbmmdwvbhrgxbh4g4in4anu-story.html |access-date=2023-08-24 |website=[[New York Daily News]]}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web |date=2022-09-12 |title=Columbia University ranking scandal raises questions over sky-high value of an Ivy League education |url=https://money.yahoo.com/columbia-university-ranking-scandal-raises-130038574.html |access-date=2023-08-25 |website=money.yahoo.com |language=en-US}}</ref>
